question: Which of the following is NOT an alkaline earth metal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Na**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Alkaline earth metals belong to **Group 2 of the periodic table**, which includes elements with two electrons in their outermost shell.
 
• Na (Sodium) is not an alkaline earth metal; instead, it is an alkali metal, which belongs to Group 1 of the periodic table.
 
• Mg (Magnesium), Ca (Calcium), and Be (Beryllium) are all part of Group 2, making them alkaline earth metals.
 
• Alkaline earth metals are **known for their reactivity**, though not as reactive as alkali metals, and **they form basic (alkaline) compounds when they react with water**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Element
 Details
 
 

 1) Na
 Sodium (Na) is **an alkali metal**, not an alkaline earth metal. It has **a single electron in its outermost shell**.
 
 

 2) Mg
 Magnesium (Mg) is an alkaline earth metal with **two electrons in its outer shell**, making it highly reactive.
 
 

 3) Ca
 Calcium (Ca) is another alkaline earth metal, essential for living organisms, especially in bone formation.
 
 

 4) Be
 Beryllium (Be) is the **lightest alkaline earth metal** and has **high melting point and excellent thermal stability**.
